title: Construction Projects (建案大師)
summary: Explore how a library reading room comes together, from foundations to finishes, then open Skyline Builder 3D for a second construction activity.
summaryZhTW: 從基礎到裝修，逐層探索圖書館閱覽室的建造過程，再進入第二個單元「天際線建造師 3D」。
coverAlt: A cutaway library model with exposed turquoise ducts, a concrete frame and a crane above the reading room.
controls: In the reading room, drag to orbit or use the camera buttons. Select a phase to examine the model.
limitations: The reading-room exercise focuses on one ventilation connection.

approval.note: The creator requested publication of the two-module collection.
